title: Chehlum karne aayi hoon Ay Mere Ghazi Abbas
body:
Ay Mere Ghazi Abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
Chehlum Karne Aayi Hoo
kehti Hai Umme Kulsoom
aake Lehad Par Ay Mazloom
mai Zehra Ki Jaayi Hoo
<<MINI>>
ay Mere Ghazi Abbas
chehlum Karne....
<<DIVIDER>>
tum Pa Hue Hai Zulm O Sitam
raah May Thay Be Parda Hum
pusht Pe Durre Khaayi Hoo
<<MINI>>
ay Mere Ghazi Abbas
chehlum Karne....
<<DIVIDER>>
thi Jo Amanat Bhai Ki
wo Zindan May Choot Gayi
qabr Banakar Aayi Hoo
<<MINI>>
ay Mere Ghazi Abbas
chehlum Karne....
<<DIVIDER>>
be Parda Bazaaro May
ay Bhaiya Darbaro May
dukh Par Dukh Mai Paayi Hoo
<<MINI>>
ay Mere Ghazi Abbas
chehlum Karne....
<<DIVIDER>>
tujh Pa Hue Wo Ranj O Mehan
baazu May Thi Mere Rasan
sham Se Chut Kar Aayi Hoo
<<MINI>>
ay Mere Ghazi Abbas
chehlum Karne....
<<DIVIDER>>
roti Hai Mujh Par Ghurbat
dekho To Meri Haalat
neel Rasan Ke Laayi Hoo
<<MINI>>
ay Mere Ghazi Abbas
chehlum Karne....
<<DIVIDER>>
pahunchakar Haq Ka Paigham
ay Bhaiya Darbar E Shaam
khutba De Kar Aayi Hoo
<<MINI>>
ay Mere Ghazi Abbas
chehlum Karne....
<<DIVIDER>>
qabr Pa Bhai Ki Rokar
shehzadi Kehti Thi Nazar
ujda Kunba Laayi Hoo
<<MINI>>
ay Mere Ghazi Abbas
chehlum Karne....
